title: Phase 27 15-State ES-EKF Blackout Failure Forensic Audit & Physical Correction

forensic_discoveries.name: Benchmark Evaluator Sensor Frame Bypass
forensic_discoveries.description: The benchmark evaluator passed raw smartphone-frame IMU directly to ES-EKF without executing PhoneToVehicleAligner.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Uncalibrated 105 deg to 174 deg smartphone mounting yaw and tilt corrupted IMU propagation.

forensic_discoveries.name: Aligner Cold-Start Standstill Starvation
forensic_discoveries.description: PhoneToVehicleAligner required 15 standstill frames with low variance; drives starting in continuous motion never calibrated, defaulting R_p2v to identity.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Filter ran on unaligned raw frame for up to 553 seconds.

forensic_discoveries.name: Uncalibrated Smartphone Accelerometer Vertical Scale Bias
forensic_discoveries.description: Consumer smartphone accelerometer measured specific force norm 9.51 to 10.16 m/s^2 rather than standard 9.80665 m/s^2.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Uncompensated vertical bias generated fictitious vertical acceleration integrating to downward velocity v_z < 0.

forensic_discoveries.name: NHC Attitude-Velocity Destabilization Coupling
forensic_discoveries.description: Downward velocity v_z < 0 coupled via NHC Jacobian H[1,7] = v_x into nominal attitude, pitching the vehicle downward by 30 to 70 deg.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Tilted 9.8 m/s^2 gravity into the forward axis (g sin theta ~ 7.5 m/s^2), causing catastrophic runaway (>50 m/s velocity error, >3000 m position error).

forensic_discoveries.name: Unestimated Gyro DC Bias & Lack of Dynamic Leveling
forensic_discoveries.description: Smartphone MEMS gyros possess 0.02 to 0.09 rad/s DC bias. Without dynamic gravity leveling or initial bias estimation, open-loop attitude integrated gyro bias linearly.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Continuous pitch/roll drift leading to gravity leakage.

forensic_discoveries.name: Chi-Square Gate Lockout Due to Acceleration Runaway
forensic_discoveries.description: Because gravity leakage accelerated nominal velocity by 5 to 10 m/s between 1.0s AI inferences, AI speed innovation exceeded NIS gate (>9.0) and was rejected 79.8% to 100% of the time.
forensic_discoveries.impact: Filter was starved of valid AI speed corrections.

corrections_implemented: Added in-motion dynamic vertical axis estimation to PhoneToVehicleAligner (calibrates within 2.0s without standstill).
Implemented initialize_leveling(acc_meas, yaw_rad) in ES-EKF to align initial quaternion with gravity and initialize scale bias.
Implemented update_gravity_leveling(acc_meas, forward_speed, yaw_rate, fwd_acc) to continuously bound pitch and roll drift during cruising.
Corrected 1 Hz GPS freshness handling in benchmark evaluator to prevent 10 Hz repeated fixes from pulling velocity to zero.
Updated ESEKFConfig process noise parameters to reflect consumer smartphone IMU uncertainty.
